feature: Live document PDF download, decoupled from insights-documents (Phase 1 of Epic #660 Share & Export)
notes: GIT #1043 (sub-issue of Epic #660, via #660's own build-plan comment). insights-documents / insightsGeneratedDocumentsTable / printTokensTable / portal-documents.ts are DEPRECATED for this feature and are not exercised here — this manifest covers the clean build against the live-rendered document set only.

NEW SURFACE COVERED: GET /api/portal/live-documents/:docType/pdf (live-document-pdf.ts) — mints a documentPrintTokensTable token, builds the docType-keyed print URL (buildLiveDocumentPrintUrl, portal-url.ts), and calls renderLiveDocumentToPdf (insight-pdf.ts, reused unmodified) to navigate the real Document Viewer route and print the actual rendered page. The 200/%PDF apiTest below is genuinely end-to-end: headless Chromium navigating that URL exercises the NEW /auth/document-print-exchange route and auth-context.tsx's new docPrintToken boot-effect branch too, not just the minting route in isolation.

Also covers the docId route-matching fallback added to copilot-readiness-documents.tsx (Git #1043): a live-rendered document has id:null by design (journeyModel.ts), so /copilot-readiness/documents/:docId now also matches a docType string, not just a numeric id. The uiSteps below deep-link by docType (copilot_readiness) and assert the correct report opened.

WHAT THIS MANIFEST DOES NOT ASSERT: full PDF visual/layout correctness (manual spot-check, same discipline as remediation-tracker-e2e.json's export.pdf/evidence-pack.pdf) — only that a real, non-empty %PDF comes back. Also does not assert the old id-based /api/portal/insights-documents/:id/pdf path, which is untouched by this change and already outside this manifest's scope.

ENV VARS required in BuildConsole -> Settings -> Test Environment Variables: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL, TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD, TEST_PORTAL_SLUG (same designated testbed Assessment account every other copilot-readiness manifest uses).

LAST REAL RUN (shaneapp://runTest, 2026-08-14, worktree HEAD before this session's commit): 4/10 — HONEST RED, not a manifest defect. POST /api/auth/login (200, real bearer) and the negative controls (unknown docType, 404 as expected via the route's own 404 for the unmounted path) pass; GET /api/portal/live-documents/copilot_readiness/pdf 404s ('Cannot GET') and the deep-link UI steps fail to hydrate #email, because shaneapp://runTest executes against the DEPLOYED Replit origin (per CLAUDE.md's shaneapp-runtest-hits-deployed-build-not-worktree note), which does not yet carry this session's new route/schema/page changes — those exist only in this session's commit at run time. Same expected-red class as #1041/#1042's own undeployed-surface notes. SHANE TO-DO: run the manual SQL migration (lib/db/migrations/manual/2026-08-14-document-print-tokens-1043.sql), then redeploy api-server (new route + auth exchange) and msp-portal (docType fallback + export wiring) — once deployed, re-run this manifest for a real pass/fail.
